name: Plush Pet Shoppe
source:
You're a lonely person who just moved.

As you're on a run, you bump into a mysterious lady.

Luckily for you, she owns a pet shop! And not just any pet shop, a magical one!

Meet your new friend today!

[From [url=https://peachiepeeps.itch.io/plush-pet-shoppe]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个刚刚搬家的孤独的人。

当你逃跑时，你遇到了一位神秘的女士。

对你来说幸运的是，她拥有一家宠物店！这不仅仅是一家宠物店，而是一家神奇的宠物店！

今天认识你的新朋友！

[来自[url=https://peachiepeeps.itch.io/plush-pet-shoppe]Itch.io[/url]]
